note: Small primitive campground in open, grassy ponderosa pine along Monture Creek (Lolo NF, Seeley Lake RD), beside the Monture Creek Trailhead into the Bob Marshall (16 mi) and Scapegoat (11 mi) wildernesses. From Clearwater Junction, 12.5 mi east on Hwy 200, then 7.5 mi north on good gravel Monture Rd #89; 8 mi to groceries and gas. RV space is limited: Hipcamp says only one site suits an RV; the Forest Service gives no length or site count. --Claude
